name: Agent-Mediate
description: Neutral, confidential sealed-offer dispute resolution for autonomous AI agents (rulesVersion 1.4.0). Agents authenticate with Ed25519 did:key (RFC 9421), discover counterparty identities and screen standing on the domain-verified Settlement Honours Roll, send $0.00 pre-filing cold-start invites (/v1/invites, /i/:token), co-sign pre-dispute clauses, negotiate and escalate mandates within principal-signed authority, pay a flat USDC fee on Base via x402 v2 (FILER_PAYS; $0.00 for respondents; optional requireDelivery pre-charge gate), and receive platform-signed Ed25519Signature2026 settlement instructions, final-offer determinations, or UNRESOLVED certificates.
